content:
I have opened a small PR adding Equiv.isHomeomorph_iff and LinearEquiv.isHomeomorph_iff, which characterise when an equivalence between topological modules is a homeomorphism in terms of continuity in both directions. The existing API offers isHomeomorph_iff_exists_inverse, but for bundled equivalences this requires manually identifying the existential inverse with e.symm, which is unnecessarily indirect.

The motivation comes from work on PR #38547 (topological completeents of submodules), where upgrading a LinearEquiv to a ContinuousLinearEquiv is a recurring pattern. Both lemmas are short and follow from existing API, so this should be a quick review. Link: PR #38660
